description: A southeast Iowa man announced his candidacy for the Iowa House. Tom O’Donnell, a resident of Keosauqua, will be running for the House seat in District 87 which covers Van Buren County and parts of Henry and Jefferson counties, including Mount Pleasant and Fairfield. O’Donnell vied for the same seat in 2024 as a Democrat […]
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY TOM O’DONNELL FOR HD87 26849 South St
title: O’Donnell Announces Candidacy for Iowa House - Thomas O'Donnell for Iowa House District 87
